# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Shared Devices Office Web File Associations

Makes the app Office op het web the default for Word, Excel and PowerPoint files on shared devices, so that a double-click on a file in OneDrive or SharePoint opens it in Office for the web, and opens scripts such as .js, .vbs and .hta with Notepad.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | Own baseline — Policy CSP ApplicationDefaults/DefaultAssociationsConfiguration with the ProgIds of the Win32 app IntuneTemplate/WIN/Apps/office-web-open, plus the associations of [Baseline] - WIN - D - Script File Associations. |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Shared_Devices_Office_Web_File_Associations.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Shared_Devices_Office_Web_File_Associations.json) |

> Belongs on SG-D-UEM-WIN-Shared, together with the Win32 app Office op het web (IntuneTemplate/WIN/Apps/office-web-open) on the same group. Without that app the association points to a ProgId that does not exist and Windows ignores it. Also contains the script associations of [Baseline] - WIN - D - Script File Associations: two policies with Default Associations Configuration on one device are a Conflict. That policy is in phase 2 on the pilot, where shared devices do not belong; exclude SG-D-UEM-WIN-Shared as soon as it moves to phase 1, and copy any change to its list here. Windows applies the associations at sign-in.
